brief:
Israeli forces conducted widespread military operations across southern Lebanon on Tuesday, launching artillery strikes and airstrikes while demolishing residential buildings in multiple areas, Shehab Wire reported. The operations included detonations targeting homes and movements of military vehicles throughout the region.

The Lebanese news agency documented the assaults targeting several zones in the south. The attacks combined aerial bombardment with ground-based artillery fire and systematic destruction of civilian structures, though specific locations, casualty figures, and the stated objectives of the operations were not immediately detailed in available reports.
